profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Shield AI

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Development · Autonomous Vehicles · Software Integration

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained C++ components for a radar modeling and simulation system supporting system integration and testing
• Implemented cross-component messaging and data flow, improving reliability across distributed modules
• Balanced model fidelity and performance trade-offs to achieve near real-time system behavior
• Debugged complex system issues using GDB, logging, and runtime analysis to identify root causes across interacting components
• Resolved dynamic linking and shared library issues (e.g., symbol resolution, dependency conflicts) in Linux environments
• Maintained and enhanced gmake-based build workflows for a large multi-component codebase
• Integrated Fortify SAST into the build process, enabling automated vulnerability scanning across multiple repositories
• Used generative AI tools to assist with debugging, prototyping solutions, and analyzing system behavior

positions.title: Systems Engineer II
positions.description:
• Supported delivery of APG-82(V)1 AESA radar systems, ensuring alignment with system requirements and operational readiness
• Led system-level verification and validation (V&V) for radar software releases, ensuring compliance with customer and mission requirements
• Served as a deputy lead for production support, providing on-call troubleshooting and guiding technicians in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
• Performed failure analysis on radar system components, identifying faulty modules and recommending replacements to restore functionality
• Designed and implemented cross-team integration workflows between Jira and internal failure tracking systems, improving visibility across software and hardware teams
• Automated SAP data retrieval and processing using Excel VBA, reducing manual effort and improving data accuracy
• Ported and maintained Python-based data pipelines on Linux systems to support failure analysis and reporting
• Managed and customized Jira workflows, improving task tracking and team coordination

positions.title: Retail Systems Co-op
positions.description:
- Managed and supported Chase Paymentech retail POS systems
- Collaborated with our cloud solutions provider, Aptos, to diagnose and resolve users' issues
- Utilized SAP and internal business intelligence applications for data validation
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Excel VBA · Customer Service

positions.title: Engineering Aide - Aircraft Launch & Recovery Software Engineering Team
positions.description:
- Researched and designed an embedded system prototype for an upgrade to the aircraft recovery equipment’s display system
- Consulted with the cyber security team to ensure the prototype’s design met all security requirements
- Analyzed various real-time operating systems, such as FreeRTOS, for cyber vulnerabilities to determine the best operating system for the embedded system
- Developed internal Excel macros to facilitate the processing of artifacts provided by the contractors
positions.insights: Skills: Excel VBA · Analytical Skills · Creo Parametric

positions.title: IT Security Co-op
positions.description:
- Managed system access privileges for computers and applications using Active Directory and Microsoft Exchange Server
- Implemented security controls to protect data in the shared network environment
- Debugged and developed internal Excel visual basic scripts in collaboration with a team member
positions.insights: Skills: Troubleshooting · Problem Solving · Excel VBA · Active Directory · Customer Service · Analytical Skills · Microsoft Exchange

positions.title: Engineering Aide – Visual Landing Aids Team
positions.description:
- Operated naval visual landing aid [VLA] equipment to test for operation faults
- Converted hand-drawn electrical drawings to AutoCAD drawings to be more accessible for employees
- Conducted a cost analysis of VLA equipment and researched possible solutions to meet budget needs for flight deck lighting
- Reviewed and updated VLA equipment manuals

positions.title: QA Tester/ Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Responsible for testing and validating derivatives pricing applications in accordance with client and internal requirements
- Used technical and analytical skills to create and execute the test cases and automate any testing
Worked with Oracle and SQL databases
